questions.question: A colleague rolls their eyes at an idea. Which horseman is this?
questions.answer: Contempt. It is the most serious of the four.

questions.question: How can you raise a concern without criticising the person?
questions.answer: Use "I" to say how a specific behaviour affects you, and leave out any judgement of the person.

questions.question: How is a time-out different from stonewalling?
questions.answer: When you stonewall, you leave without a word and the other person feels ignored. In a time-out, you say you need a few minutes to think, then you return to the conversation.
